channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant, instead of trickling out daily. Each Sunday's drop carries every grant added that week, except any closing on the drop day itself.

item.title: Follow Fluxus: After Fluxus Scholarship 2026/27 (EUR 10,000, 3-month studio and exhibition, Wiesbaden)
item.description: Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden, with the City of Wiesbaden · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 grant plus a rent-free 70.88 sqm live/work studio at the Kunsthaus Wiesbaden for three months and a follow-up exhibition at the Nassauischer Kunstverein. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP x Sumud: Residency for Palestinian Artists in Helsinki, Spring 2027 (EUR 3,600 working grant)
item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: ART4MENTAL open call for artists: VR content for mental-health support (EUR 5,000 sub-grants)
item.description: ART4MENTAL (Creative Europe project) · deadline 11 Nov 2026 · Sub-grant of up to EUR 5,000 per artist for 20 selected artists (EUR 100,000 pool), plus VR training, mentorship, a residency in the Ukrainian Carpathians and exhibition opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: TRACES Art & Science @ Energypolis 2027: residency at the EPFL Laboratory for Energy Materials (Sion)
item.description: Foundation for the Sustainable Development of Mountain Regions (FDDM) with EPFL Valais-Wallis · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · Artist stipend of CHF 2,000 per month (CHF 6,000 total) covering living and research costs, housing in Sion, travel from home and back up to CHF 1,500, and a separate production budget set by the curator. No application fee.

item.title: Fonds Soziokultur: General Project Funding, November 2026 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Fonds Soziokultur · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 5,000 to EUR 30,000 per project, covering at most 80 percent of the total project budget. No application fee.

item.title: Netherlands Embassy in Brussels: Open Call for Cultural Project Support
item.description: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Brussels · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 5,000 per project.

item.title: Kooperativa x Flanders Arts Institute: South-Eastern Europe Mobility Programme 2026-27
item.description: Flanders Arts Institute (Kunstenpunt) and Kooperativa · deadline 01 Mar 2027 · Fully funded mobility: travel costs, accommodation and per diems calculated per Erasmus+ formulas, plus up to EUR 300 for the host organisation's costs. Fifteen grants available. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Moves Europe: Call for Individual Mobility 2026-2027
item.description: Creative Europe (Culture Moves Europe), implemented by the Goethe-Institut · deadline 30 Apr 2027 · EUR 85 per day of project implementation, plus travel allowance of EUR 400 (under 5,000 km) or EUR 800 (from 5,000 km). Top-ups where applicable: green mobility EUR 400, overseas countries and territories / outermost regions EUR 175, family EUR 200 per child under 18, visa EUR 120. Accessibility support: EUR 30 per day plus actual cost or fixed allowance for personal assistance or sign language interpretation. No application fee.

item.title: HIAP: Learning Materials International Artist Residency 2027 (Suomenlinna, Helsinki)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme), with Kone Foundation · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,350 per month (EUR 4,050 total for 90 days) via Kone Foundation, material budget up to EUR 750, access budget up to EUR 1,000, one return trip covered (slow travel encouraged), plus accommodation and workspace. For collectives, the working grant can be paid to one individual only and there is no additional travel budget.

item.title: Invisible Cartographies: Residency for Neurodivergent Artists (Buinho, Portugal)
item.description: Buinho Creative Hub (Creative Europe project Invisible Cartographies) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 artist fee for the six weeks, free accommodation for the full period, travel budget up to EUR 300, plus a production budget and FabLab access. Meals not included. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.

item.title: make-a-thek: Mobility Scheme & Knowledge Exchange Programme (Europe + pilot countries)
item.description: make-a-thek (coordinated by Fab Lab Barcelona at IAAC, funded by Horizon Europe) · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · Mobility Scheme: EUR 1,000 flat stipend for experienced practitioners. Knowledge Exchange Programme: EUR 850 flat stipend. Up to 12 participants per track annually. No application fee.

item.title: EU CERV: European Remembrance 2026-27 (CERV-2026-CITIZENS-REM)
item.description: European Commission / EACEA (Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values Programme) · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · EUR 50,000 to EUR 500,000 per project, from an estimated call budget of EUR 28 million (EUR 14M Holocaust remembrance of Jewish victims; EUR 5M genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity incl. Roma and LGBTIQ+ victims; EUR 5M colonialism, slavery and migration; EUR 4M democratic transitions). No application fee.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: Onassis ONX: ONX Seeds 2026, Soft Circuits for Hard Times (Athens, hybrid)
item.description: Onassis ONX (Onassis Foundation) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 to 5,000 seed funding per project, set by scope; up to four projects selected. Plus weekly technical, curatorial and business mentoring, online masterclasses, studio and equipment access at Onassis Ready for Athens-based teams, and presentation at ONX Exhibition Athens (17 to 21 March 2027) with travel, accommodation and artwork transport covered for non-Athens participants. No application fee.

item.title: City of Timisoara Project Centre: Mobilities for Cultural Professionals 2026
item.description: Centrul de Proiecte al Municipiului Timisoara · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Maximum RON 7,500 per national mobility; maximum RON 10,000 per international mobility. Non-reimbursable, with a required co-funding of at least 1% of the project budget. No application fee.

item.title: Fondation Vocatio: Bourse Vocatio 2027 (EUR 10,000 for young talents in Belgium)
item.description: Fondation Vocatio · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 bourse per laureate, funding a concrete personal project (equipment, production, training). No application fee.

item.title: Finnish Cultural Foundation: October Round 2026 (all fields of art and science)
item.description: Finnish Cultural Foundation (Suomen Kulttuurirahasto) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Around EUR 49 million awarded annually across roughly 2,100 grants; recent October rounds have averaged over 450 working and project grants covering one or more years, with working grants extending up to four years. No application fee.

item.title: ACC Galerie Weimar: 33rd International Studio Program 2027, On Absence
item.description: ACC Galerie Weimar and the City of Weimar · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · EUR 1,100 per month stipend for four months, plus a rent-free furnished studio apartment and a group exhibition the following year. No application fee.

item.title: Auslandsstipendien von Bund und Laendern 2028 (Villa Massimo, Casa Baldi, Venice, Paris)
item.description: Kulturstiftung der Laender / BKM (German federal and state governments) · deadline 15 Dec 2026 · Villa Massimo: EUR 3,000/month; Casa Baldi: EUR 3,000/month; Deutsches Studienzentrum Venedig: EUR 1,534/month; Paris: approx. EUR 1,500/month. Accommodation and studio provided at all locations. No application fee.

item.title: Flemish Government: Kunstendecreet beurzen voor kunstenaars (March 2027 round)
item.description: Flemish Government, Department of Culture, Youth and Media (Kunstendecreet) · deadline 15 Mar 2027 · Beurs opkomend talent (emerging talent): EUR 7,500 lump sum for 1 year. Beurs bewezen talent (proven talent): EUR 12,000 per year, for 1, 2 or 3 years. No application fee.

item.title: Hessische Kulturstiftung: Reise- und Residenzstipendien 2027/2028 (18th round)
item.description: Hessische Kulturstiftung · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Travel grants of EUR 25,000 (3 to 12 months), plus access to up to EUR 7,700 additional production funding after the grant. 14 grants over two years: 5 travel, 7 residency (NYC, London, Paris, Istanbul, Kyoto), 2 combined. NOTE: figures are from the call text as republished verbatim by listing sites; the official funding-guidelines PDF was unavailable at the time of adding, so verify on hkst.de. No application fee.

item.title: Nordic Culture Fund: ENTER 2026 (exploratory cross-border collaboration)
item.description: Nordic Culture Fund · deadline 16 Oct 2026 · Up to DKK 50,000 (roughly EUR 6,700), plus up to DKK 25,000 in additional accessibility support for logistics and access needs, for a maximum total of DKK 75,000. No co-funding required. No application fee.

item.title: La Biennale di Venezia: Biennale College Blend, 2nd edition (EUR 20,000 award)
item.description: La Biennale di Venezia · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · One Biennale College Blend Award of EUR 20,000 to the most compellingly structured project. Accommodation covered for the Venice workshop (travel not covered). No application fee.

item.title: EFFEA Call #5: European Festivals Fund for Emerging Artists
item.description: European Festivals Association (EFA) · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · 50 residency grants: 40 Discovery grants of EUR 8,000 (for artists at an early career stage) and 10 Springboard grants of EUR 15,000 (for artists established at home and ready to break through internationally). A minimum of 80 percent of the grant must cover costs incurred by the artists (fees, travel, accommodation, subsistence). An own contribution of EUR 1,000 (Discovery) or EUR 2,000 (Springboard) is deducted from the paid grant. No application fee.

item.title: PACT Zollverein: Residencies January to July 2027 (Essen)
item.description: PACT Zollverein · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · Weekly grant allowance of EUR 400 per residency participant (max 4 people), plus studio space (69 to 173 sqm, one barrier-free), local accommodation (max 4 people; barrier-free and family-friendly by arrangement), travel costs for one journey per participant to and from PACT, and technical equipment and professional support by arrangement. No application fee.

item.title: Next Nature: Heaven's Hospital Open Call (commissions on the future of care)
item.description: Heaven's Hospital / Next Nature Museum · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · Three selected projects each receive a budget of EUR 15,000 for the development of a first prototype or artistic intervention. Selected participants become Heaven's Hospital Fellows and join an international network of designers, researchers, care professionals and artists. No application fee stated.

item.title: Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Suriname 2027 (Paramaribo, Moengo, Frederiksdorp)
item.description: Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) with local partner organisations in Suriname · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 8,500 subsidy for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL. One residency position is awarded. No application fee.

item.title: wpZimmer: Open Call 2027 residencies for collectives (Antwerp)
item.description: wpZimmer · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 (excl. VAT) financial contribution per collective, managed by the collective, plus a five-week residency with two workspaces (a technically equipped studio of approx. 18m x 17m and a medium atelier of approx. 4m x 13m adapted to physical practices) and shared accommodation for up to 6 people. Four collectives selected. No application fee.

item.title: European Cultural Foundation: Academic Research Fellowship (ECF Historical Archives)
item.description: European Cultural Foundation, hosted at the Historical Archives of the European Union · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 grant to support a research stay at the HAEU, covering travel, accommodation and living expenses. The parallel Artistic Research Fellowship carries EUR 10,000 and additionally covers artistic production. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • The Kitchen / Central Location Open Call (foodculture days Biennale, Vevey 2027)
    https://opencall.foodculturedays.com/en
    foodculture days · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · CHF 15,000 all-inclusive project budget (VAT included), covering travel, visas, equipment and additional kitchen equipment rental, per diems, materials and artist fees. Food costs and accommodation in Vevey are covered separately by foodculture days. Three shortlisted collectives each receive a CHF 250 research fee to develop their proposal in Phase 2. One collective is selected. No application fee.
  • Le Garage Moderne: OASIS International Artist Residencies 2026 (Bordeaux)
    https://legaragemoderne.org/oasis2026
    Le Garage Moderne (European OASIS project) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Five grants. Each artist receives a fee of EUR 1,300 gross (taxes may apply depending on legal status), up to EUR 600 for production expenses such as raw materials, technical services or special tools, a lump-sum travel grant scaled to distance with top-ups for green travel options, a per diem of EUR 45 per day, and accommodation in a self-catering hotel. Access to the shared tools and spaces of Le Garage Moderne is included, subject to the association's regulations. No application fee.
  • Teatri Riflessi 2027: Short Performance Competition (12th edition)
    https://www.iterculture.eu/en/teatri-riflessi/tr2027/tr12/
    IterCulture APS · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Gross performance fee of EUR 500 to EUR 1,100 (VAT included) per selected short performance, scaled by the number of performers on stage, plus a possible travel contribution of up to EUR 250 subject to available funding, place of origin, cast size and absence of external touring grants. At least 10 performances are selected. Competition prizes: Best Performance EUR 1,200; Best Dramaturgy, Best Direction, Best Performer and the Scholars' and Critics' Award EUR 500 each; 'Valentina Nicosia' Fund EUR 500; 'Sandra Bressan' research fund EUR 1,800; Youth Jury Award EUR 300; plus non-cash awards (Audience Special Mention, Companies' Choice, Technical Crew). Panel members and Teatri Riflessi Network partners may also award special prizes in the form of artist residencies and touring opportunities. Application is free; selected companies pay a EUR 50 deposit that is fully refunded after the festival.

item.title: 5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
  • American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Kone Foundation: Annual Grant Call (2026)
    https://koneensaatio.fi/en/grants/grantapplicants/criteria-for-applying/
    Kone Foundation / Koneen Saatio (Finland) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Artistic groups and organisations up to EUR 250,000; research groups typically EUR 200,000 to 500,000. Minimum project duration six months for individual applicants and one month for groups; maximum four consecutive years for the same project. No co-financing requirement stated. No application fee. No retroactive funding.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.
  • Vilem Flusser Residency for Artistic Research 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/vilem-flusser-residency-for-artistic-research-2027
    transmediale and the Vilem Flusser Archive, Universitat der Kunste Berlin (UdK) · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · Two-month residency with an artist fee of EUR 1,500 per residency month. NO funds are available for travel or housing. For duos or collectives the fee remains the same and is shared. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Grounding the Cloud 2026
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-grounding-the-cloud
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 30,000 per grant. No application fee.
  • Columbia Institute for Ideas and Imagination: Paris Fellowship 2027-28
    https://ideasimagination.columbia.edu/apply/applying-for-a-fellowship/
    Columbia University Institute for Ideas and Imagination · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 75,000 stipend, plus housing at Reid Hall in Paris and office and research support, September 2027 to May 2028. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• MOVIDA: Labs on Dance and Technology 2026/27
    https://movida.dance/news/call-labs/
    MOVIDA (Movement and Virtual Intelligence for the Development and Accessibility of Artists and Audiences) · deadline 03 Aug 2026 · EUR 1,200 gross per artist (EUR 2,400 per duo), plus travel and accommodation covered, plus a production budget of up to EUR 500 per duo. Accessibility and personal-assistance costs are covered by separate agreement. No application fee.
  • Association Francoise pour l'oeuvre contemporaine x Cite internationale des arts: Research and Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.citeinternationaledesarts.fr/appels-a-candidature/association-francoise-pour-loeuvre-contemporaine-x-cite-internationale-des-arts/
    Association Francoise pour l'oeuvre contemporaine / Cite internationale des arts · deadline 16 Aug 2026 · Grant of EUR 1,000 net of tax per month, plus a furnished studio-apartment (20 to 35 sq m, combining living and working space), international return travel to Paris airports or stations, travel insurance, and capped research support against receipts. Additional fees apply for accompanying persons. No application fee.
  • Reflection (All Disciplines)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/reflection
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000 (cannot exceed 50 percent of total budget). No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Stichting DOEN: Funding for Pioneering Culture and Social Initiatives (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://www.doen.nl/aanvraag-doen/
    Stichting DOEN · deadline Rolling / undated · No fixed amounts published; funding is tailored per initiative. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• British Council Ireland: UK-IRL Culture Connects Grant 2026/27
    https://www.britishcouncil.ie/programmes/arts/uk-irl-culture-connects-grant-202627
    British Council Ireland / Arts Council Ireland · deadline 31 Jul 2026 · Up to EUR 3,000 per collaboration (smaller amounts also eligible), covering artist fees (including your own time), collaborator fees, travel and accommodation, studio or space hire, materials, and access costs including disability support. No application fee.
  • Night as Commons and the Dark Side of Light: Residency (Transylvania)
    https://www.hypha-etc.ro/events/call-for-applications-night-as-commons-and-the-dark-side-of-light
    Hypha etc. · deadline 01 Aug 2026 · EUR 30/day allowance, plus accommodation and travel (EUR 400 under 5,000 km; EUR 800 over), with green mobility, family, and accessibility top-ups. EU-funded. 6 weeks. No application fee.
  • Medialab Matadero: Situated Research Residencies 2027 (Madrid)
    https://www.medialab-matadero.es/en/announcements/situated-research-2027
    Medialab Matadero · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 10,000 per project (before taxes) for three selected projects, plus individual workspace, Fablab and technical materials, curatorial guidance, and logistical and financial support for public activities. No application fee.
  • Rijkscultuurfondsen: Interdisciplinary Grant
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/interdisciplinary/
    Dutch national cultural funds (Rijkscultuurfondsen), via the Mondriaan Fund · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · Individual-maker track: EUR 24,900 for 12 months (income cap EUR 55,000 including the grant; awarded once per maker). Organisation track, two fixed tiers: EUR 12,500 for projects budgeted EUR 15,000 to 60,000, or EUR 50,000 for projects budgeted EUR 60,000 to 500,000. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• National Gallery of Iceland: CUSP Artist Residency (Reykjavik 2027)
    https://www.listasafn.is/en/art/news-vasulka-stofa/
    National Gallery of Iceland (Listasafn Islands), CUSP project · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · Accommodation and working space for the residency; travel and subsistence stipend; an artist fee for collaborating in the open-lab/masterclass; and, depending on the artist's request and museum means, hardware and software for the working space. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• RAMDAM, un centre d'art: Extended Possibilities Residency 2027
    https://ramdamcda.org/actualite-ramdam/extended-possibilities-residency-call
    RAMDAM, un centre d'art · deadline 14 Jul 2026 · EUR 1,350 per resident allowance for subsistence and other costs, plus travel allowance of EUR 400 (under 5,000 km) or EUR 800 (from 5,000 km). Top-ups: green mobility EUR 400 per resident (600 km or more by non-plane transport), visa EUR 120, outermost regions/OCT EUR 175, family EUR 200 per child under 18. On-site accommodation and technical facilities provided. Supported by Culture Moves Europe.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Manuel António da Mota Prize – 17th Edition (2026)
    https://www.fmam.pt/edicao-em-curso-introducao/
    Fundação Manuel António da Mota (FMAM) · deadline 30 Jun 2026 · Total prize fund. The winning application receives a cash prize of EUR 50,000. Second and third place receive EUR 25,000 and EUR 10,000 respectively. The remaining 7 applications (honourable mentions) each receive a cash prize of EUR 5,000.
